content.text: In many regions, creators face significant barriers when attempting to sell digital products due to platform restrictions. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, leaving many potential sellers in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan without viable options. This post delves into the limitations of platforms like Gumroad and Payhip for creators in restricted countries, and presents sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-2|infrastructure]] as a permanent solution.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip provide easy-to-use platforms for digital product sales, but their accessibility is limited. Gumroad is favored for its simplicity and user-friendly interface, enabling creators to sell directly to consumers. Payhip, on the other hand, focuses on digital downloads and subscriptions, offering features like discount codes and affiliate marketing. However, both platforms are plagued by geographical restrictions that prevent creators in many regions from utilizing their services effectively. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a robust alternative that empowers creators by allowing them to build their own online stores, independent of location-based limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip have stringent policies that exclude users from a significant number of countries, particularly those with unstable financial systems or regulatory concerns. This exclusion not only limits access to potential income sources but can also create uncertainty for creators when their accounts are flagged or suspended. For example, a PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, leaving creators in a precarious financial situation. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, eliminates such risks by allowing users to retain complete control over their sales and transactions, regardless of their geographical location.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Both Gumroad and Payhip charge fees on every transaction, which can add up quickly, especially for creators working on tight margins. The payment processing times can also vary, leading to delays in receiving funds. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure utilizes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-7|NOWPayments Integration]] for automatic crypto payment processing, ensuring quick transaction confirmations with minimal fees. With transaction costs often under $0.10 on recommended networks like BSC and Solana, creators can keep more of their earnings. This transparency in cost and speed makes sovereign commerce a superior choice for creators in restricted regions.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control, eliminating reliance on restrictive platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One critical drawback of platforms like Gumroad and Payhip is that creators do not own their customer data or the infrastructure used to sell their products. This lack of ownership means creators are at the mercy of platform policies and potential service interruptions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, grants full ownership to creators post-deployment, allowing them to manage their own customer relationships and sales without third-party interference. With [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-explained-digital-9|COREMERCH guide to automated]] payment processing and instant product delivery, creators can operate their businesses seamlessly and independently.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and technical capabilities. If you need a quick setup with minimal complexity, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a viable option, deploying in just 48 hours. For those who require more advanced features and greater scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack offers a comprehensive solution, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and support for up to five products. By leveraging these stacks, creators can establish a reliable and sustainable online business without relying on traditional payment processors.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the best alternative, as it allows you to create your own online store with direct payment processing, ensuring you are not restricted by geographical limitations.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Using PayPal in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan is often problematic due to account restrictions and potential fund holds. It's advisable to consider sovereign commerce solutions that provide greater reliability.
What are the fees associated with using Gumroad or Payhip?
Gumroad and Payhip charge transaction fees on every sale, typically ranging from 5% to 8%. This can significantly reduce your earnings, especially for low-cost digital products.

Most sovereign commerce stacks can be deployed within 48 hours, allowing you to quickly establish your online store and start selling your digital products.
